subject: cli/cognition-compact-human-output
statement: Routine cognition human output should report the newly recorded semantic item plus compact state counts instead of reprinting the entire accumulated task cognition on every call. Machine-readable --json remains the complete projection.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Implement R6.4 Context Recall & CLI Friction from 0.15.3 dogfood: bounded possibly-related durable cues, compact cognition output, research help discoverability, and semantic exit-code documentation.
